answers.question: What changed this week?
answers.answer: Login failures spiked after the latest app update: 23 reports in the last 7 days against 1 the week before, in English, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Arabic. Customers say they cannot sign in since updating; one adds that the password reset email never arrives.

answers.question: What are customers saying about payments?
answers.answer: Two separate problems: customers charged twice for one subscription (English, Portuguese, German), and checkout failing at the payment step (English, German, Arabic).

answers.question: ¿Qué es lo que más gusta a los clientes?
answers.answer: El soporte, que resuelve los problemas en minutos, y el nuevo diseño, que describen como más limpio y bonito.
